title: SearchSpace
description: The 'show your options' contract. Declares everything the host allows KAV to try, as typed parameters — not code. A point in this space is a complete configuration; an ExperimentSpec selects exactly one point (Law 2).

parameters.description: Typed, bounded parameters. Each is independently settable; combinations are formed by KAV, one hypothesis at a time (ADR-002).

defaults.description: The champion/baseline configuration: parameter name -> value. Every experiment starts from here and changes as little as possible.

name.description: Parameter path in the host's config (e.g. 'model.learning_rate').

type.description: Deliberately minimal type system. No expressions, no functions, no code (Law 5).

domain.description: Bounded domain. Every parameter MUST be finite and enumerable — unbounded search spaces are rejected (Law 2).

mutable.description: false = frozen for now; declared but excluded from current experiments.

cost_hint.description: Optional relative cost of varying this parameter, to inform budgeting.
